title: Palette data
description: The `data` of a palette entry: a saved plant list that isn't a built project (a design mock-up, a firm standard, or a list for a planting condition), and optionally the site conditions it is for. Geography is derived from `site.location` (P6); compatibility is derived over the list and the site (P3).

site.description: The conditions the palette is for. Each condition may state several values (a part-sun, part-shade site).

hardinessZone.description: A USDA zone (`8` or `8b`); a whole zone stands for both halves. Derived from `location` once the zone layer exists (D33), when not given.

location.description: WGS 84, decimal degrees, at most 5 decimal places; must fall inside WA, OR, or CA (lib/validate.ts).
